why: The HUD's cue lifetime drifts from `--hud-duration-slow`, the length the stylesheet runs every stock-loss cue for (issue #230). At 600 a rebuild in the last 100 ms of a cue drops it while it is still visibly fading, so it vanishes rather than finishing. The hud.match cases cannot see this -- they advance time BY the constant, so they agree with any value -- which is why the agreement with the token is pinned in the stylesheet test.
killedBy: hud.css: the stock-loss cue arms (issue #230) runs for exactly STOCK_CUE_MS -- the token the cues use is the constant the HUD expires them by
